ValidationRule.description:
Can not modify Deal Validation Field Value once an Opportunity is Won
#21199 #24480 -Making Applicable for all record type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Deal_Validation__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT($Permission.Deal_Validation_Decision_Maker), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Validation cannot be updated in Stage 5/6/7. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
